summary: The native driver's lease renewals answer with the step's row view instead of folding the step's whole history

replay.detail: No claim, projection or cache changes; nothing is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No table, index, view, trigger or storage version changes.

rules.detail: A renewal commits the same lease and claims as before; only what the response carries changes when the caller asks for it.

compatibility.detail: POST /v1/work/renew/{subject} accepts an optional ?view=lease. Without it a renewal answers exactly as before. An older daemon ignores the query and answers with the full view, which the driver does not read; any other view value, or view=lease on another action, is refused as invalid-work-view.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores full renewal answers; the driver never reads them, so nothing else changes.
